scope: Guided OneBox pipeline projection, ranked reference selection, competitor analysis, and local test discovery

checks.evidence: GET /api/guided/[id] and POST /api/reference/[id] use the existing same-origin local API authorization boundary; route tests cover forbidden requests.
The guided read endpoint sends private, no-store and nosniff headers and returns only typed run projections.
Ranked IDs and notes are strictly bounded, candidate membership is checked server-side, writes are serialized per run, and conflicting checkpoints return 409 without mutation.
ReferenceLockDraftSchema omits preferenceLedger, so model-authored lock drafts cannot fabricate owner preference provenance; only the atomic server selection path writes the ledger.

Only verified business sites with first-party crawl artifacts reach analysis; model input excludes ratings, review counts, directory rank, and social popularity; uncited rubric criteria are forced to zero.
Competitor URLs are restricted to HTTP(S), screenshot paths are constrained to research-relative artifacts, React escapes all prose, and external links use noopener noreferrer.
Local draft JSON is validated against the current run/version candidate set, bounded, and never sent until the user confirms.
Existing developer rendering is unchanged, historical selections normalize in memory, and guided market reads fall back to legacy scan.json when the new artifact is absent.
Evidence-gated runs cannot surface Website ready until the current visual-qa artifact has a valid human approval; built=done without that checkpoint remains workflow-running or approval-pending.

verification.browser: Desktop, 390px, and 320px; no horizontal overflow or console errors; 44px switch target; developer toggle verified
verification.independentReview: PASS after verifying visual-QA completion gating, SSE resume, model provenance isolation, and local draft validation

knownNonBlocking: Next.js reports six pre-existing Turbopack dynamic-filesystem tracing warnings in contrastGate.ts, cssVars.ts, gates.ts, and siteAuthority.ts.
